mentions.name: InterAuth
mentions.description: A tool for sharing a single Google Doc or Sheet with an AI agent without going through the heavyweight OAuth/GCP setup, using disposable email addresses as the workaround for granting access.
mentions.problem: The author needed a way to share a single Google doc/sheet with an agent and didn't want to go through the heavy OAuth GCP project.
mentions.source_excerpt:
1. https://interauth.dev/

Share a single google doc with your agent (w/o oauth mess)

I needed a way to share a single google doc/sheet with my agent

I didn’t want to go through the heavy oauth gcp project so I’m using disposable email addresses as the work around
